notes: Five graduate schools run PhDs at Aarhus University; STEM programmes sit in Natural Sciences (GSNS), Technical Sciences (GSTS) and Health. GSNS and GSTS share the same fee and English levels. Health sets its own English rules (biomed record). No GRE page was found on any of the graduate school pages checked. Health open calls take a Danish or equivalent master's degree; Health pages were checked at phd.health.au.dk. Not saved: Agroecology, Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Food Science and Quantitative Genetics (GSTS) and Public Health and ClinFO (Health) have no matching field. Molecular Biology & Genetics (GSNS) and Ecoscience (GSTS) are separate programmes not saved as their own records; see the biology and environment notes.
